g.text: A moving disturbance outruns acoustic waves when its Mach number exceeds one

text.style: font-size: 9px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #59636c

g.text: Source moves right through a stationary uniform medium with sound speed a; at the shown instant the source is at the origin and earlier wave centers lie
behind it. These are small-disturbance Mach cones, not finite-strength shock angles. Hypersonic convention is roughly M≥5; thermal/chemical effects are not
modeled. Panel coordinate spans differ to fit the emission histories.
